title: CPF Module Schema: Machine Learning Compute Cluster module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-machinelearningcomputecluster'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s).

description_compute_instance.description: (Optional) The description of the Machine Learning Compute Instance.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type.

local_auth_enabled.description: (Optional) Should local authentication be enabled? Defaults to false.

machine_learning_workspace_id.description: (Required) The id of the machine learning workspace

max_node_count.description: (Required) Maximum node count. Changing this forces a new Machine Learning Compute Cluster to be created.

min_node_count.description: (Required) Minimal node count. Changing this forces a new Machine Learning Compute Cluster to be created.

node_public_ip_enabled.description: (Optional) Should nodes have public IP addresses enabled? Defaults to false.

scale_down_nodes_after_idle_duration.description: (Required) Node Idle Time Before Scale Down: defines the time until the compute is shutdown when it has gone into Idle state. Is defined according to W3C XML schema standard for duration.

ssh.type: object({ admin_username = string admin_password = string key_value = string })
ssh.description: (Optional) An ssh block as defined below. object({ admin_username = (Required) Name of the administrator user account which can be used to SSH to nodes. Changing this forces a new Machine Learning Compute Cluster to be created. admin_password = (Optional) Password of the administrator user account. Changing this forces a new Machine Learning Compute Cluster to be created. key_value = (Optional) SSH public key of the administrator user account. Changing this forces a new Machine Learning Compute Cluster to be created. })

ssh_public_access_enabled.description: (Optional) Should SSH public access be enabled? Defaults to false.

subnet_resource_id.description: (Optional) Virtual network subnet resource ID the compute nodes belong to.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

vm_priority.description: (Required) The priority of the VM. Changing this forces a new Machine Learning Compute Cluster to be created. Accepted values are Dedicated and LowPriority.

id.description: The Resource ID of the Machine Learning Compute Cluster.

name.description: The Name of the Machine Learning Compute Cluster.

resource.description: The Machine Learning Compute Cluster resource.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Machinelearningcomputecluster' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
